title: Interactor
tagline: Interactor - authenticated smart token based messaging. Send messages via your NFTs
description:
This prototype developer messaging tool brings instant messaging into your wallet via "smart" tokens. It enables any token issuer to interact with any token holders and vice versa. It allows tokens to communicate with services which identify themselves with an Ethereum key.

This project consists of a web server, AlphaWallet, ERC721 tokens and the authenticated proxy bridge.

In real world scenario this can be used for token owners to interact with services provided by favourite brands etc.

It could also be used - in this example - for an authenticated bulletin board style system where only token holders can interact.
how_its_made:
This project uses an authenticated proxy bridge, ERC721 "Smart" tokens powered by TokenScript with ERC5169, TokenScript Engine embedded in Alphawallet. 

The authenticated proxy bridge serves communications between two ethereum powered services, eg IoT devices, Java servers and Smart Tokens.
